name: Enemies in the Water
summary: Naga gather near old troll ruins off the coast, while the Horde is already pressed by attacks on its caravans. You are asked to answer this threat and show that you are proving your worth.

sections.title: Reports from the Coast
sections.body: The Horde has received reports of naga gathering near old troll ruins beneath the sea. Bloodscalp and ogre attacks are already straining its defenses, so a threat from the water gives little room for delay. You are asked to confront the Brinescale skirmishers and bring back their tridents as proof.

sections.title: A Message at Grom’gol
sections.body: At Grom’gol, the tridents you bring back are meant to be planted outside the gates. Their display will warn that the Horde is not to be trifled with, and your work earns the commander’s praise.

faq.q: Why are the naga near the coast?
faq.answer: Reports say the naga are gathering around old troll ruins beneath the sea.
The threat comes from Brinescale skirmishers, a group of naga reported near the coast.

faq.q: Why does the Horde want the naga dealt with?
faq.answer: The Horde is already stretched thin defending its caravans from Bloodscalp and ogre attacks, and fears a surprise assault from the sea.
You are asked to bring back Brinescale tridents as proof of your success.

faq.q: What will happen to the tridents?
faq.answer: They will be planted outside Grom’gol’s gates as a warning that the Horde is not to be trifled with.

faq.q: How does this prove my worth?
faq.answer: The commander praises your work and says you are quickly proving your worth to the Horde.

angles.text: The Horde seeks to protect its caravans while keeping watch for a possible attack from the sea.

attribution: In-game quest text: Enemies in the Water
